default.description: Main-window capability. Every application command is granted explicitly (SAM-039) so any single command can be revoked here. Ordered by risk tier: read-only (scan/list/get/validate/report, including the pkexec-elevated deep scan), mutating-local (apply, rollback, checkpoint CRUD via pkexec), remote (host CRUD, remote scan, fleet operations over SSH), config (scheduler, notification test, config-file picker, policy exception authoring via pkexec).
